title: AON-1 3U CubeSat

assembly.title: -Z frame, switch brackets, switches
assembly.text: Fit AON-106 brackets to the -Z frame W taps with H4 (0.20 N·m). Hang SW1/SW2 (BP-03) on the brackets with H5 (0.10 N·m). Check the lever travel by hand.
assembly.check: levers free; switch clicks at 0.5 mm

assembly.title: Rails to the -Z frame
assembly.text: Stand the four rails in a squaring fixture (100.00 gauge block box). Seat the -Z frame bar ends on the rails, fit H1 at A1/B1 (0.45 N·m). Rails AON-101 at +X+Y and -X-Y (notch at -Z).
assembly.check: envelope 100.0 ±0.1 at -Z; levers in the notches, 1.5 proud

assembly.title: Rods, end board, lower stack
assembly.text: Thread the 4 Ti rods through the -Z frame; E07 + thin nuts H3 under it. Stack spacers -01 / E02 / -02 / E01 / -03 / E03; measure the gap to the mid frame, face spacer -04 to fit.
assembly.check: stack connectors fully mated; gap -04 recorded

assembly.title: Mid frame
assembly.text: Lower the mid frame between the rails over the rods; H1 at A2/B2 (0.45 N·m).

assembly.title: Upper stack: COM
assembly.text: Spacer -05, E04, coax BP-08 routed up; measure and face spacer -06.

assembly.title: +Z frame, antenna board, springs
assembly.text: Fit the +Z frame (H1 at A3/B3), standoffs H7 on the rods (0.6 N·m: this preloads the stack), E05 with H8. Screw the spring plungers BP-04 into the AON-102 rails.
assembly.check: spring noses 2.0 proud; rods do not turn

assembly.title: Solar panels
assembly.text: Pads H9 on the mid-frame bars. Connect each panel harness (AON-E02), then fit the panels with H2 (0.20 N·m). E06A (RBF port) on +X.
assembly.check: bond < 10 mΩ panel to rail; RBF fitted
